intro.text: A princess of Idris and King Dedelin's third child, who falls between her sisters on most counts: taller than Siri but shorter than Vivenna, more proper than Siri but less so than Vivenna.
A princess of Idris and King Dedelin's third child, who chose as a girl to become an Austrine monk. She sits between her sisters Vivenna and Siri in nearly everything.

items.text: Fafen had been schooled in politics and courtly ways as a fallback, should Vivenna die before she could be wed. Picking blackberries with Vivenna after Siri has been sent to Hallandren instead, Fafen supposes that Vivenna will now be heir rather than Ridger.

appearance.text: As a monk she wears white robes and keeps her head shaved. Her curvy figure caught men's attention in Bevalis, but her vows kept suitors at a distance, since anyone who married her would have to become a monk too.

personality.text: She tends not to think things through until they are put right in front of her, so people often have to be blunt to get through to her.

She made her choice to become a monk before she turned ten and has kept to it ever since, growing food for the poor, doing work around the city and caring for those who cannot look after themselves. Siri is glad it is Fafen, not her, who lives that life.
